title: Timed Branch Initialization
statement: Let $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $b$ be a Boolean, and let $T$ be a natural number. If $D$ halts on $x$ within $T$ steps with output the one-symbol word $[b]$, then there are a natural number $a \le 2T+5$, work-tape contents for the $D$-tape block, and head positions for that block such that after $a$ steps the timed conditional machine reaches the configuration obtained by placing the initial configuration of the branch machine selected by $b$ in its branch-tape block, with those contents and head positions on the $D$-tape block and with $b$ stored on the extra tape.
hypotheses_covered: D, M₁, M₂ are finite machines over Bool
D computes [b] from x within T steps
